methods.what: Repeating arrangement of the numbers 1–7 on a square grid. Each unit is a 3×2 block (7 4 / 5 3 / 1 6) plus a single 2. The block alternates with its left-right mirror (4 7 / 3 5 / 6 1) in shifted rows.
